name: carwhere
description: VIN decoding and original window sticker lookup, powered by CarWhere and official NHTSA data.

interface.longDescription: CarWhere gives ChatGPT read-only vehicle lookups. Decode any 17-character US-market VIN through the official NHTSA vPIC database — year, make, model, trim, engine, drivetrain, body style, and plant of manufacture — plus every open NHTSA safety recall and CarWhere's verified buyer-paid pricing data for recent model years. It can also locate a vehicle's original factory window sticker (Monroney label) as a PDF, sourced directly from the manufacturer, for GM, Ford, Lincoln, Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram, Hyundai, and Genesis vehicles. Useful for car shoppers verifying a listing, owners checking recalls, and buyers researching original equipment and MSRP. Limitations: US-market vehicles only; window stickers are not available for every brand or model year; it does not search dealer inventory or contact sellers.
defaultPrompt: Find the original window sticker for my VIN
Does my car have any open recalls?
